page.layout: One printed page. At the top, the heading INDEX centred. Below it two columns of index entries, left column then right column. Below the columns, FINIS centred, then the imprint in larger type, then a printer's device (woodcut ornament) centred at the foot.

main_text.head: INDEX
main_text.l: de vxore in manu viri & quru[?]

page.notes: The left edge of the page is torn and dark; the first line of the left column and some line starts may be cut off. "quru[?]" is doubtful. "s.aniformanda" begins with a mark I could not identify; read as printed. The printer's device under the imprint is a woodcut ornament with a central face or mask and foliage, not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. Stains and show-through are present and were omitted.
